title: Advisory Decision
description: Rule output contract for the Demerzel Policy Engine AIW decisions (#589). Emits an advisory, dry-run decision based on the rule evaluation.

rule_id.description: The unique identifier of the rule that was evaluated.

subject.description: The entity the rule was evaluated against.

decision.description: The advisory outcome of the rule evaluation. Mutation is prohibited.

reason_codes.description: A list of structured reason codes justifying the decision.

evidence_refs.description: References to artifacts, logs, or metrics supporting the decision.

next_actions.description: Recommended actions for the human or agent to take.

confidence.description: The confidence level of the decision.
